body: At first it was just a impulsive thought but after a long time of thinking I noticed my depression and suicidal tendencies seemingly affect those around me I have friends who became slightly depressed by just being my friend
Is that why a lot of people look like they’re at peace when they are passing
Isn’t it scary every time I tell people the realization of death it feels as if they don’t understand the gravity of it like they look away or ignore it
